description: This file defines the AWS SDK client class for interacting with the Amazon Chime SDK Media Pipelines service. It declares methods for creating, deleting, retrieving, listing, and updating media pipeline resources.

classes.name: ChimeSDKMediaPipelinesClient
classes.description: The client class used to interact with Amazon Chime SDK Media Pipelines service, providing methods to manage media pipeline resources.

methods.name: createMediaInsightsPipelineConfiguration
methods.description: Creates a configuration for media insights pipeline.

methods.name: createMediaLiveConnectorPipeline
methods.description: Creates a media live connector pipeline.

methods.name: createMediaPipelineKinesisVideoStreamPool
methods.description: Creates a Kinesis Video Stream Pool for media pipelines.

methods.name: deleteMediaInsightsPipelineConfiguration
methods.description: Deletes a media insights pipeline configuration.

methods.name: deleteMediaPipelineKinesisVideoStreamPool
methods.description: Deletes a Kinesis Video Stream Pool.

methods.name: getMediaCapturePipeline
methods.description: Retrieves details of a media capture pipeline.

methods.name: getMediaInsightsPipelineConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves details of a media insights pipeline configuration.

methods.name: getMediaPipeline
methods.description: Retrieves details of a media pipeline.

methods.name: getMediaPipelineKinesisVideoStreamPool
methods.description: Retrieves details of a Kinesis Video Stream Pool.

methods.name: getVoiceToneAnalysisTask
methods.description: Gets a voice tone analysis task.

methods.name: startVoiceToneAnalysisTask
methods.description: Starts a voice tone analysis task.

methods.name: stopVoiceToneAnalysisTask
methods.description: Stops a voice tone analysis task.

methods.name: updateMediaPipelineKinesisVideoStreamPool
methods.description: Updates a Kinesis Video Stream Pool.
